cohort: 172 women with singleton pregnancies who underwent cesarean delivery due to placenta previa between December 2008 and October 2018.
finding: Compared to posterior placenta previa, anterior placenta previa was associated with a higher rate of previous cesarean delivery, placental accreta spectrum, lower neonatal hemoglobin at birth, higher rates of neonatal blood transfusion and prolonged maternal hospitalization, lower placental weight, and an increased rate of maternal vascular malperfusion lesions.
